changes: Lookdev: physical sky presets with a sun, height fog, `meshGradient` backgrounds, HDRI rotation and ground projection, 6 new built-in HDRIs (softbox, warehouse, city, night-city, forest, beach), one-line light rigs (`catalog lightRigs`), contact shadows, shadow settings, rect panel lights and volumetric spots, 19 new material presets (car paint, ceramic, marble, velvet, diamond, soap bubble…), physical material parameters, texture slots with procedural textures (`{ "procedural": "marble" }`) and triplanar mapping, 10 new shaders.

Cinematic post effects: `look` presets, ambient occlusion, god rays, lens flare, FXAA / SMAA / TAA, tilt-shift, halftone, ASCII, glitch, sharpen, colour grading looks, depth of field with `focusOn`; `target.quality` tiers (auto / low / medium / high / ultra) drop costly passes on weak devices; `check` reports `budget.gpu` and warns about expensive post effects.

Typography: 13 kerned fonts (Inter, Montserrat, Space Grotesk, Bebas Neue, Anton, Playfair Display, JetBrains Mono, Fredoka, Pacifico, Lobster), `maxWidth` wrapping, outlines, `splitLetters` with per-letter timeline targets (`title/0`), `reveal` animations; SVG logos gain strokes, `keepColors` and `fit`.

Motion: every easing family plus `cubicBezier()`, `spring()` and `steps()`, per-key eases, relative values, multi-target stagger selectors, markers and segments, manual triggers, scroll-driven timelines (`timeline.scroll`), camera shots, shake and look-at, model clip / blend / morph tracks, 6 new behaviours (spring, parallax, tilt, breathe, noise, lookAt), and `scene.interactions` (hover / click rules, `openUrl`) with the new `interactions_set` AI tool.

Real rigid-body physics (cannon-es, in a lazy chunk): bodies that tumble, stack and roll, impulses and forces, joints (hinges with motors), collision events with impulse and speed, `character` controllers and `fixedRotation`.

Content: new character parameters, 6 new generators (floating island, globe, crystals, galaxy, 3D bars, abstract shapes), better water, clouds and grass, new particle presets (smoke, fire, petals, leaves, galaxy dust, bokeh) and emitter shapes, new built-in product, prop and character models (some CC BY: exports credit them in CREDITS.txt).

Smart `assets optimize`: a target size per texture from how the scene uses it, WebP, meshopt geometry compression, optional simplification, `--dry-run` with real savings; `export --optimize` ships optimised copies and leaves the sources untouched.

Web embeds: `` gains `aspect`, `alt`, `autoplay`, `paused`, `loop`, `quality`, `interactive`, `data-*` bindings (`{data.key}` in the scene), methods (`play`, `pause`, `seek`, `setData`, `trigger`, `reload`, `ready`), events and CSS parts; exports add a slotted ``, `og-image.png`, Subresource Integrity, `--cache-bust`, `--base-url`, `--format zip|gif`, `EMBED.md` and React / Vue / Svelte wrappers.
Renders: `render --video` (MP4 H.264 or WebM, frame-exact), `--gif`, `--webp`, `--quality high|ultra` supersampling, `--transparent`, `--scroll` and scroll events in `--input`.
Studio: transform gizmos (move / rotate / scale) in the viewport, an English / French interface, and an edit mode that pauses the scene (scripts and triggers run in interact mode, `I`).

Landscapes: terrain shapes `basin` (a lake ringed by mountains) and `valley`, `edgeFalloff` (no cut walls at the borders), absolute `snowHeight`, `waterPlane: false` to pair a terrain with its own `water` object, mirror-lake `water` `reflections`, and a `birds` generator (one draw call: drifting V formations, orbiting or path-following flocks).

Scenes: `attach: "camera"` keeps captions and chapter labels on screen during camera shots and scroll stories; HUD texts and `visible` expressions read `timeline.progress`, `.segment`, `.marker` and `.time`; HUD theming with per-element `color` / `background`, a `panel` style for game-over screens and auto-contrast button labels (`ui.buttonText`); the `road` generator takes `curbColors`, `vergeColor` and `verge: false`.
Colour keyframes, interaction colour transitions and `colorCycle` blend in OKLCh by default (saturated in-between colours instead of grey); `colorSpace` on a track picks `oklab`, `rgb` or `hsl`.

Physics: kinematic moving platforms carry the characters standing on them (sliding lifts, elevators, turntables), small character corrections keep contacts and `grounded()`, and measured colliders use the object's own geometry (decorative children no longer enlarge a platform's box; `compound` without `shapes` merges them).

Renders: `render --segment <name>` plays a timeline segment from the start (scenes waiting for a click), `--reduced-motion` shows what reduced-motion visitors see, `--input` also drives videos / GIFs / WebP and accepts HUD button clicks (`ui`), emitted events (`emit`) and segments, and `check` counts triangles and draw calls per frame across every pass (shadows, AO pre-pass, contact shadows, transmission, mirrors) with the causes named.

Exports report the page weight a visitor downloads (`pageKb` / `pageKbGzip`: runtime entry + the chunks this scene loads + its files) next to `folderKb`, and `--prune-runtime` copies only the chunks the scene loads.
MCP: `render_preview` returns its contact sheet as a JPEG (several times smaller than PNG) and tool results are compact JSON, with `structuredContent` only for small results.

Looks: deterministic seeks, IBL-correct `toon` shading, glass that refracts cleanly on dark and light backdrops, contact shadows whose `far` follows what stands on the plane, sturdier god rays, physical sky presets retuned for exposure 1, a more robust lazy start.

Skills, docs and recipes rewritten for the new features, with premium defaults per target kind and validated recipes (now including a lane runner game, a mirror-lake valley and a scroll story with chapter labels); the AgentCMS block reserves the scene's aspect ratio, ships the poster as markup and supports cache-busted exports.
actions: Dynamic physics bodies now rotate (real rigid bodies). A script-driven player or character that must stay upright needs `"character": true` (or `"fixedRotation": true`) on its `physics` block; check your games with `agent3d render --input …`.

Font ids are unchanged but now map to new, kerned typefaces (`sans-bold` / `sans` = Inter, `serif-bold` / `serif` = Playfair Display, `mono` = JetBrains Mono, `display` = Fredoka): text widths change slightly — re-render scenes with 3D text and check nothing is cut at the edges.

The `chromatic` post effect is radial by default (`"radial": false` restores the uniform shift) and `film` grain is gentler with scanlines off by default (`scanlines`): re-render scenes that use them and adjust `amount` / `intensity` if needed.

Scenes with models compressed by `assets optimize` / `export --optimize` (meshopt, the default) need `'wasm-unsafe-eval'` in the page's `script-src` if the site sets a Content-Security-Policy; use `--compress none` to avoid it.

`agent3d scene patch` now asks for confirmation when an op replaces a whole collection (`set` / `merge` on `lights`, `postfx`, `objects`, `timeline.tracks`, `ui.elements`, `interactions`…): scripts and agents that patched those without `--yes` get `needsConfirmation` with `plan.replaces`; re-run with `--yes` (or patch single items by id, e.g. `lights#key.intensity`).

`toon` materials now keep the environment fill and show their `color` as written in the lit band: toon scenes come out brighter and truer to the brand colours. If you had brightened toon colours to compensate, restore the real colours and re-render.

Physical sky presets are retuned to look rich at the default `exposure` (1, now a multiplier of the preset's own value): remove `exposure` overrides you added to fix washed-out skies (values around 0.4–0.6 now look too dark), then re-render.
Character scripts that carried the hero on a moving platform themselves (adding the lift's motion every step) must stop doing it: the engine carries characters now, so the hero would move twice.

Update the skills (`/plugin update agent3d` in Claude Code, or `npm run hermes:build` for Hermes) so agents pin `@fleox/agent3d@0.2.0`; re-export embeds to get the new runtime (cannon-es and meshoptimizer are bundled, no new install step).

changes: First release. Scenes are JSON (`scene.json`): targets (banner, hero, card, square, fullscreen, inline, game), camera and controls (orbit, parallax, scroll, follow), environments (gradients, sky, HDRI, fog, ground), lights, objects (meshes, 3D text, glTF models, SVG logos, generators, particles, instances), materials and shaders, behaviours, a keyframe timeline, post effects, physics, HUD, synth sounds and sandboxed game scripts.

The `agent3d` CLI: `new` (starters per target and templates), `scene get|summary|apply|patch|validate`, `object`, `timeline`, `catalog`, `templates`, `check` (validation, sandbox lint, budgets, framing, licences, web settings), `render` (headless Chrome, deterministic frames and contact sheets), `serve` (live preview), `studio`, `export` (embed, single-html, poster, video), `assets` (built-in CC0 library, Poly Haven / ambientCG / Khronos search and download, Kenney / Quaternius zip import), `tools`, `mcp`, `doctor`.
MCP server (`agent3d mcp`): the AI tool catalog plus `render_preview`, which returns the contact sheet as an image so multimodal clients can look at their work.
Built-in library of CC0 models, PBR textures, HDRIs and fonts, usable offline as `library:<id>`.

Runtime `<agent3d-scene>` Web Component: lazy start, pause off-screen, reduced motion, pixel ratio cap, poster fallback without WebGL, accessible label, responsive aspect ratio; no network calls to third parties.

Agent skills for Claude Code (`agent3d-create`, `agent3d-edit`, `agent3d-assets`, `agent3d-game`, `agent3d-publish`) and their Hermes Agent version with a Python wrapper; an AgentCMS plugin with an "Agent3D scene" editor block.
